description: This PHP file defines the 'Fraud' controller class within the OpenCart admin extension framework. It manages listing, installing, and uninstalling fraud detection extensions, handling related permissions, loading language and view templates, and interfacing with models for extension management.

classes.name: Fraud
classes.description: Controller class for managing fraud extension modules within the OpenCart admin panel, providing CRUD operations and integration points for fraud detection extensions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point that outputs the list of fraud extensions by invoking getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads available fraud extensions, checks installed ones, and prepares data for the view, including URLs for actions and extension details.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a fraud extension, including permission checks, file existence validation, registering controllers/models, and invoking optional install routines.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process, including permission validation, removing the extension from the database, and calling any uninstall routines.
